# Money v6.0.0 - Table of Contents

## Pages

- [Introduction to Money](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [LICENSE](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Money](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.md): Money implements a set of functions to store, retrieve, convert and perform
arithmetic on a `t:Money.t/0` type that is composed of a currency code and
a decimal currency amount.
- [Money.Application](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.Application.md)
- [Money.Currency](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.Currency.md): Functions to manage currencies including ISO 4217 currencies
and custom (private-use) currencies.
- [Money.Currency.Store](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.Currency.Store.md): Persistent-term-backed store for custom currencies.
- [Money.Financial](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.Financial.md): A set of financial functions, primarily related to discounted cash flows.
- [Money.Sigil](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.Sigil.md)

- Exchange Rates
  - [Money.ExchangeRates](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.ExchangeRates.md): Implements a behaviour and functions to retrieve exchange rates
from an exchange rate service.
  - [Money.ExchangeRates.Cache](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.ExchangeRates.Cache.md): Defines a cache behaviour and default inplementation
of a cache for exchange rates

  - [Money.ExchangeRates.Cache.Dets](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.ExchangeRates.Cache.Dets.md): Money.ExchangeRates.Cache implementation for
:dets

  - [Money.ExchangeRates.Cache.Ets](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.ExchangeRates.Cache.Ets.md): Money.ExchangeRates.Cache implementation for
:ets and :dets

  - [Money.ExchangeRates.Cache.EtsDets](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.ExchangeRates.Cache.EtsDets.md)
  - [Money.ExchangeRates.Callback](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.ExchangeRates.Callback.md): Default exchange rates retrieval callback module.
  - [Money.ExchangeRates.Config](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.ExchangeRates.Config.md)
  - [Money.ExchangeRates.OpenExchangeRates](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.ExchangeRates.OpenExchangeRates.md): Implements the `Money.ExchangeRates` for the Open Exchange
Rates service.
  - [Money.ExchangeRates.Retriever](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.ExchangeRates.Retriever.md): Implements a `GenServer` to retrieve exchange rates from
a configured retrieveal module on a periodic or on demand basis.
  - [Money.ExchangeRates.Supervisor](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.ExchangeRates.Supervisor.md): Functions to manage the starting, stopping,
deleting and restarting of the Exchange
Rates Retriever.

- Subscriptions
  - [Money.Subscription](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.Subscription.md): Provides functions to create, upgrade and downgrade subscriptions
from one plan to another.
  - [Money.Subscription.Change](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.Subscription.Change.md): Defines the structure of a plan changeset.
  - [Money.Subscription.DateError](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.Subscription.DateError.md)
  - [Money.Subscription.NoCurrentPlan](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.Subscription.NoCurrentPlan.md)
  - [Money.Subscription.Plan](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.Subscription.Plan.md): Defines a standard subscription plan data structure.

  - [Money.Subscription.PlanError](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.Subscription.PlanError.md)
  - [Money.Subscription.PlanPending](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.Subscription.PlanPending.md)

- Exceptions
  - [Money.CurrencyAlreadyDefinedError](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.CurrencyAlreadyDefinedError.md)
  - [Money.CurrencyNotSavedError](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.CurrencyNotSavedError.md)
  - [Money.ExchangeRateError](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.ExchangeRateError.md)
  - [Money.FormatError](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.FormatError.md)
  - [Money.Invalid](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.Invalid.md)
  - [Money.InvalidAmountError](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.InvalidAmountError.md)
  - [Money.InvalidCurrencyError](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.InvalidCurrencyError.md)
  - [Money.InvalidDigitsError](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.InvalidDigitsError.md)
  - [Money.ParseError](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.ParseError.md)
  - [Money.UnknownCurrencyError](https://ex-money.hexdocs.pm/Money.UnknownCurrencyError.md)
